items.q: The interviewee Danny Barker does not speak in the provided context; the mention of 'August' is entirely within the interviewer's monologue about his family.

ctx.x: My father was named August. My brother was named August. He named his son August. And then his son is named August. So now we've got five. We've got August, Senior, August, Junior, August the Third, August the Fourth and August the Fifth.
